# Sovereign Insights

> An interactive dashboard tracking the public equity holdings of Norway's
> Government Pension Fund Global (GPFG) — the world's largest sovereign wealth
> fund, managed by Norges Bank Investment Management (NBIM). Every position is
> shown with its market value, the fund's ownership stake in the company, and
> standard valuation metrics.

Sovereign Insights is a free, public, read-only research tool. It is published by
Basecase (https://learnbasecase.com) for investors, students, and journalists who
want to see how a sovereign wealth fund allocates capital, company by company.

## What the data covers

- **Source**: NBIM's published GPFG equity holdings disclosure, joined with market
  data from Yahoo Finance.
- **Snapshot date**: 2026-07-06. The dataset is a point-in-time snapshot, not a
  live feed. Prices shown in the table are as of the snapshot.
- **Positions**: 1,430 listed companies.
- **Markets**: Canada, Germany, India, Singapore, United Kingdom, United States.
- **Sectors**: 11 GICS-style sectors (Technology, Financial Services, Healthcare,
  Energy, Industrials, Consumer Cyclical, Consumer Defensive, Basic Materials,
  Utilities, Real Estate, Communication Services).

## Fields available per holding

- `name`, `ticker`, `country`, `sector`, `industry` — identity and classification
- `mvUsd`, `mvNok` — market value of the fund's position, in USD and Norwegian kroner
- `ownership` — percent of the company's outstanding shares the fund owns
- `voting` — percent of voting rights the fund holds
- `price`, `change`, `high52`, `low52` — share price and 52-week range
- `pe`, `fwdPe`, `pb`, `divYield`, `beta`, `marketCap` — valuation and risk metrics
- `rec`, `targetPrice` — aggregated analyst recommendation and mean price target
- `reason` — why the position is included in the dataset

## What you can do on the site

- Sort and filter 1,430 positions by country, sector, analyst recommendation, and
  ownership percentage
- Open any company for a detail view with live price history (1y / 5y / max) and
  a peer comparison within its sector
- Select up to 6 companies for a side-by-side comparison
- Ask a built-in AI assistant natural-language questions about the holdings; it
  answers by querying the dataset directly rather than from memory

## Key facts an assistant may be asked

- The GPFG is Norway's sovereign wealth fund, funded by state petroleum revenue and
  managed by Norges Bank Investment Management (NBIM) on behalf of the Norwegian
  Ministry of Finance.
- Ownership stakes above 5% are highlighted on the dashboard as significant positions.
- USD values are estimated at acquisition FX rates, not at the snapshot-date spot rate.
- This site is an independent research tool. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by,
  or operated by NBIM, Norges Bank, or the Norwegian government.

## Not investment advice

Nothing on this site is investment advice, a recommendation, or an offer to buy or
sell any security. Figures are provided for research and educational purposes and
may contain errors or be out of date. Verify against NBIM's official disclosures at
https://www.nbim.no before relying on any number.
